title: Asgard fragment (tree/json)
description: A fragment a server returns for a region: one node, or a list of nodes. See protocol.md §9 and §10.
$comment: Rules from §9 and §10 that this schema cannot check: (1) §9.3 says the root stack/tabs elements are rejected, but the doc does not name their types, and `stack` is also an ordinary layout element, so they are not listed here. (2) Whether an element type exists in this build is the client's question (§9.4). (3) §9.3 says `_`, `native-` and `native:` prop keys are stripped by the client; this schema rejects them, since a well-behaved server never sends them. (4) `navigate` must match a route the device knows when tapped (§12.4). (5) `navigate` is limited to 2048 bytes; maxLength counts characters, so a path with multi-byte characters can pass here and still be too long. (6) `http:` media URLs are allowed only when the client has app.debug on (§9.6); this schema allows https only.

oneOf.description: Several root nodes, as when a Blade view has more than one root tag (§9.5).

node.description: One element in the tree (§9.1). It carries no node ids or callback ids; the client makes those (§9.2).

type.description: The element type name, such as column or text. The client decides whether it can render it (§9.4).

not.$comment: §9.3: no screen chrome and no nested regions.

key.description: Stable identity among siblings. Relative to the parent, never an id (§9.2).

class.description: Tailwind classes, resolved on the device.

allOf.description: §9.3: a webview in a fragment cannot use php mode.

php.description: Must be off. A php-mode web view loads the app's own routes.

props.description: Free-form presentational props, written by the server.

propertyNames.description: §9.3: no compiler-internal keys such as _press, _navigate or native-key.

mediaUrl.description: A URL the device loads: an absolute https URL with a host, or an empty string for no image (§9.6).

pressSlot.description: A press slot: a method call, a navigation or a back (§10.1, §12.4).

valueSlot.description: A change or submit slot. It can only call a method; the control's value is appended to args (§10.1). It cannot navigate (§12.4).

call.description: Runs a method. On the server by default, or on the device with target client (§10.2, §10.3).

args.description: Arguments, passed in order. A server always sends this, even when empty; a client treats a missing one as empty.

target.description: Where the method runs. Absent means server.

navigate.description: Moves the app to an app path (§12.4).
An app path: one leading slash, no scheme or host, no backslash, no whitespace or control characters.

replace.description: Replace the current screen instead of pushing a new one.

transition.description: One of the client's screen transitions.

argValue4.description: An argument: a plain JSON value, nested at most 4 deep.

argValue3.description: A plain JSON value, nested at most 3 more deep.

argValue2.description: A plain JSON value, nested at most 2 more deep.

argValue1.description: A plain JSON value, nested at most 1 more deep.

argScalar.description: null, a boolean, a number or a string.
